class.name: RailVehicleSpeedControl
class.description: [RailVehicleSpeedControl] wraps the FIZ [code]SpeedControl:[/code] section, configuring the vehicle's cruise control: whether it is present, its response curve, and its optional pneumatic-brake intervention.

method.name: get_desired_power
method.description: The power the speed control is allowed ([code]SpeedCtrlUnit.DesiredPower[/code]).

method.name: get_desired_velocity
method.description: The speed the speed control holds [km/h] ([code]SpeedCtrlUnit.DesiredVelocity[/code]).

method.name: get_selected_velocity
method.description: The speed selected on the speed control [km/h] ([code]SpeedCtrlValue[/code]).

method.name: get_set_velocity
method.description: The speed set by an impulse lever, in tens ([code]NewSpeed[/code]).

method.name: get_standby
method.description: The speed control is on but waiting, holding no power ([code]SpeedCtrlUnit.Standby[/code]).

method.name: speed_control_button
method.description: One of the speed buttons pressed: its speed selected ([code]SpeedCtrlButton()[/code]; [code]OnCommand_speedcontrol*[/code], [code]Train.cpp:6887-6974[/code]).

method.name: speed_control_decrease
method.description: The selected speed one step lower ([code]SpeedCtrlDec()[/code]).

method.name: speed_control_increase
method.description: The selected speed one step higher ([code]SpeedCtrlInc()[/code]).

method.name: speed_control_power_decrease
method.description: The power the speed control is allowed one step lower ([code]SpeedCtrlPowerDec()[/code]).

method.name: speed_control_power_increase
method.description: The power the speed control is allowed one step higher ([code]SpeedCtrlPowerInc()[/code]).

method.name: speed_control_set
method.description: The speed set outright [km/h], as a driver's order ([code]RunCommand("SpeedCntrl")[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:12695[/code]).

members.member: [code]SpeedControl:BrakeIntervention[/code] Whether the cruise control may assist with the automatic pneumatic brake when other means of slowing down are insufficient.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedCtrlDelay[/code] Delay before a newly set target velocity is applied.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedCtrlATOF[/code] Bitmask of actions that automatically disengage the cruise control: 1 - moving the main controller lever, 2 - braking.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedCtrlType[/code] Whether the cruise control lever is impulse-type ([code]Time[/code] in the FIZ file) rather than linear.
[code]SpeedControl:MaxPwr[/code] Maximum power the cruise control may request, in the range 0..1.
[code]SpeedControl:MaxVel[/code] Maximum settable target velocity, in km/h.
[code]SpeedControl:MinPwr[/code] Minimum power the cruise control may request, in the range 0..1.
[code]SpeedControl:MinVel[/code] Minimum settable target velocity, in km/h.
[code]SpeedControl:PwrStep[/code] Step size (0..1) for the +/- power adjustment buttons.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedButtons[/code] Predefined target velocities (up to 10 values, in km/h) selectable with number key shortcuts.
[code]SpeedControl:SpeedCtrl[/code] Whether the vehicle is equipped with cruise control.
[code]SpeedControl:VelStep[/code] Step size, in km/h, for the +/- velocity adjustment buttons.
